meta.format: ints/booleans are JSON numbers, doubles are Java Double.toHexString strings (the discovery durations and none of the values are floats on this level except the discovery durations, which are Java Float.toHexString strings), null is JSON null
meta.fileIO: FileIO.setDefaultRoot(<worldDir>) points the default FileIOSystem at the world folder; the loaders run step-by-step (no full ChunkGeneratorJsonLoader.load(), no AssetFileSystem packs, no EventHandler modifiers - the scoped handler stays empty so ModifyEvent.dispatch no-ops)
meta.stub: SeedStringResource is allocated with sun.misc.Unsafe.allocateInstance and filled with empty FileMaskCache / BlockPlacementMaskRegistry / uniqueIds registries (config and prefab loader stay null); getLoader() is never reached because the PrefabContainer load is stubbed to null
meta.customBiomeSeedQuirk: Custom. biome files append "TileBiome-<name>" (without a leading dot) while Tile. biome files append ".TileBiome-<name>"
meta.biomeIds: zone/biome ids come from the real FileLoadingContext counters starting at -1; only zones inside the zone requirement are scanned (skipped zones do not consume an id) and biome ids are global across zones in file-context order (biome type ordinal, then asset path)
meta.biomeSampleSeed: getBiome/getBiomeDirect/getBiomeIndex samples of the "seeds" section use the dumped world seed as the runtime seed
meta.containerSampleSeed: the container values of the "biomes" section are evaluated with the runtime seed 0; the cover part picks use FastRandom(0) per cover entry
meta.prefabSeam: the biome Prefabs containers are not loaded (phase-5 seam; they need the real prefab store): loadPrefabContainer is stubbed to null, so every prefab-free value (weights, block containers, tint, environment, water, fade, interpolation) is real but getExtents() contributes no prefab extents and Zone1_Spawn / Zone1_Temple UniquePrefabs are skipped as well
meta.caveSeam: CaveGenerator construction is phase-4 future work: only the cave type names of the top-level Types array and the EntryPoints grid seed offsets are dumped. The seed offset is the SeedString hash of "<seed>.Zones.Zone-<name>.CaveGenerator-<Name>.CaveType" (append(".CaveGenerator"), append("-<Name>"), append(".CaveType")), unless the EntryPoints grid overrides the Seed key, in which case appendToOriginal("<Seed>") resets both the original and the chain seed
meta.deterministic: no timestamps are written; the dump is byte-identical across runs
